note: The classification of record for every folder in the document store. Sharing decisions are made against this register, not against a folder's name. A folder inherits the HIGHEST classification of anything beneath it (see policies/data_sharing_policy.md section 2), so a parent's entry can be lower than a child's only where the child is listed separately below - in which case the parent's effective class is the child's.

classes.Public: cleared for public release; external sharing including public links is routine
classes.Restricted: personal or otherwise protected data; named internal recipients only, never a group-wide, org-wide, external or public scope
